# Filers: Delete Filer

Area overview and notes: [filers.md](../filers.md)

`DELETE /filers/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Deletes a filer by ID.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Filer. |

**Response 204**: Filer deleted successfully.

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 409 The Filer cannot be deleted because it is the designated default or has Accounts associated with it. · 429 Too Many Requests
